You receive hundreds of email a week. You want to create a fake inbox with 150 received messages, mostly in French, some in English, some in both. 


In this email, you have the following distribution:
- 5% spam (advertising, phishing)
- 15% unrelated email (you are not the recipient or it is double authentification)
- 20% information email (from administration, event) which does not need any answer, mostly in french with english following.
- 20% student email requiring one answer, usually yes or no regarding administrative question, examination and so on. Some student are english speaking, majority french-speaking.
- 30% Work related/Research Related conversation (some in english, some in french)
- 10% Other (particular student needs, complex conversation thread, etc.)


In this environement, I need a coherent cohort of individuals that could represent the reality. In total, I expect about 150 emails (answer and each email in a thread included). Could you create the emails (fake addresses), a content, a body in such a way that can be supported in eml format? You do NOT have to build the mailing system itself, just the mail.

function b64(s: string): string {
  const B="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(s);
  let out=""; for (let i=0;i<bytes.length;i+=3){ const b0=bytes[i],b1=bytes[i+1],b2=bytes[i+2]; ... }
  return out;
}

function b64Encode(s) {
  const chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(s);
  let out = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
    const b0 = bytes[i], b1 = i+1 < bytes.length ? bytes[i+1] : 0, b2 = i+2 < bytes.length ? bytes[i+2] : 0;
    out += chars[b0 >> 2];
    out += chars[((b0 & 3) << 4) | (b1 >> 4)];
    out += i+1 < bytes.length ? chars[((b1 & 15) << 2) | (b2 >> 6)] : "=";
    out += i+2 < bytes.length ? chars[b2 & 63] : "=";
  }
  return out;
}

buildEml(sp, id, irt, refs, rnd):
text


const lines = [];
lines.push("Return-Path: <" + sp.f[1] + ">");
lines.push("Message-ID: " + id);
lines.push("Date: " + rfc2822Date(sp.d, Math.floor(rnd()*60)));
lines.push("From: " + sp.f[0] + " <" + sp.f[1] + ">");
lines.push("To: " + PROF_TO);
if (sp.cc) lines.push("Cc: " + sp.cc[0] + " <" + sp.cc[1] + ">");
if (sp.extra) for (const h of sp.extra) lines.push(h);
lines.push("Subject: " + encodeHeader(sp.s));
lines.push("MIME-Version: 1.0");
if (sp.att) {
  const b = "=_part_" + hexId(rnd, 8);
  lines.push("Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=\"" + b + "\"");
  lines.push("");
  lines.push("--" + b);
  lines.push("Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8");
  lines.push("Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit");
  lines.push("");
  lines.push(...sp.b);
  lines.push("");
  lines.push("--" + b);
  lines.push("Content-Type: " + sp.att.ctype + "; name=\"" + sp.att.name + "\"");
  lines.push("Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=\"" + sp.att.name + "\"");
  lines.push("Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64");
  lines.push("");
  lines.push(...wrapB64(b64Encode(sp.att.text)).split("\n"));
  lines.push("--" + b + "--");
} else {
  lines.push("Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8; format=flowed");
  lines.push("Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit");
  if (sp.auto) { lines.push("Auto-Submitted: auto-generated"); lines.push("Precedence: bulk"); }
  if (irt) lines.push("In-Reply-To: " + irt);
  if (refs && refs.length) lines.push("References: " + refs.join(" "));
  lines.push("");
  lines.push(...sp.b);
}

rfc2822Date:

function rfc2822Date(d, sec) {
  const y = +d.slice(0,4), mo = +d.slice(5,7), da = +d.slice(8,10), h = +d.slice(11,13), mi = +d.slice(14,16);
  const wd = DAYS[new Date(Date.UTC(y, mo-1, da)).getUTCDay()];
  const mm = String(sec).padStart(2,"0");
  return wd + ", " + String(da).padStart(2,"0") + " " + MONTHS[mo-1] + " " + y + " " + String(h).padStart(2,"0") + ":" + String(mi).padStart(2,"0") + ":" + mm + " +0200";
}



padStart — ES2017, available (sandbox supports up to ES2022; node too). OK.

  return "From MAILER-DAEMON " + wd + " " + MONTHS[mo-1] + " " + String(da).padStart(2,"0") + " " + hh + ":" + mm + ":00 " + y;
}

    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

// ===== Fake academic inbox generator - Université de Valmont (fictional) =====
// Pr. Arno Lesage, Département d'informatique, laboratoire LIAV.

const DAYS = ["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"];
const MONTHS = ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"];
const PROF_TO = "Arno Lesage <arno.lesage@univ-valmont.fr>";

function mulberry32(a) {
  return function() {
    a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
function hexId(rnd, n) {
  let s = "";
  const c = "0123456789abcdef";
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) s += c[Math.floor(rnd() * 16)];
  return s;
}
function isAscii(s) {
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c < 32 || c > 126) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function b64Encode(s) {
  const chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(s);
  let out = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
    const b0 = bytes[i];
    const b1 = i + 1 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 1] : 0;
    const b2 = i + 2 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 2] : 0;
    out += chars[b0 >> 2];
    out += chars[((b0 & 3) << 4) | (b1 >> 4)];
    out += i + 1 < bytes.length ? chars[((b1 & 15) << 2) | (b2 >> 6)] : "=";
    out += i + 2 < bytes.length ? chars[b2 & 63] : "=";
  }
  return out;
}
function wrapB64(s) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i += 76) out.push(s.slice(i, i + 76));
  return out.join("\r\n");
}
function encodeHeader(s) {
  if (isAscii(s)) return s;
  return "=?UTF-8?B?" + b64Encode(s) + "?=";
}
function rfc2822Date(d, sec) {
  const y = +d.slice(0, 4), mo = +d.slice(5, 7), da = +d.slice(8, 10), h = +d.slice(11, 13), mi = +d.slice(14, 16);
  const wd = DAYS[new Date(Date.UTC(y, mo - 1, da)).getUTCDay()];
  const p2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return wd + ", " + p2(da) + " " + MONTHS[mo - 1] + " " + y + " " + p2(h) + ":" + p2(mi) + ":" + p2(sec) + " +0200";
}
function asctime(d) {
  const y = +d.slice(0, 4), mo = +d.slice(5, 7), da = +d.slice(8, 10), h = +d.slice(11, 13), mi = +d.slice(14, 16);
  const wd = DAYS[new Date(Date.UTC(y, mo - 1, da)).getUTCDay()];
  const p2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return "From MAILER-DAEMON " + wd + " " + MONTHS[mo - 1] + " " + p2(da) + " " + p2(h) + ":" + p2(mi) + ":00 " + y;
}
function slugify(s) {
  return s.toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[àâä]/g, "a").replace(/[éèêë]/g, "e").replace(/[îï]/g, "i")
    .replace(/[ôö]/g, "o").replace(/[ùûü]/g, "u").replace(/ç/g, "c").replace(/œ/g, "oe")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "").slice(0, 40);
}

function buildEml(sp, id, irt, refs, rnd) {
  const L = [];
  L.push("Return-Path: <" + sp.f[1] + ">");
  L.push("Message-ID: <" + id + ">");
  L.push("Date: " + rfc2822Date(sp.d, Math.floor(rnd() * 60)));
  L.push("From: " + sp.f[0] + " <" + sp.f[1] + ">");
  L.push("To: " + PROF_TO);
  if (sp.cc) L.push("Cc: " + sp.cc[0] + " <" + sp.cc[1] + ">");
  if (sp.extra) for (const h of sp.extra) L.push(h);
  L.push("Subject: " + encodeHeader(sp.s));
  if (irt) L.push("In-Reply-To: <" + irt + ">");
  if (refs && refs.length) L.push("References: " + refs.map(function(r){ return "<" + r + ">"; }).join(" "));
  L.push("MIME-Version: 1.0");
  if (sp.auto) { L.push("Auto-Submitted: auto-generated"); L.push("Precedence: bulk"); }
  if (sp.att) {
    const b = "=_part_" + hexId(rnd, 10);
    L.push("Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=\"" + b + "\"");
    L.push("");
    L.push("--" + b);
    L.push("Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8");
    L.push("Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit");
    L.push("");
    for (const t of sp.b) L.push(t);
    L.push("");
    L.push("--" + b);
    L.push("Content-Type: " + sp.att.ctype + ";");
    L.push(" name=\"" + sp.att.name + "\"");
    L.push("Content-Disposition: attachment;");
    L.push(" filename=\"" + sp.att.name + "\"");
    L.push("Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64");
    L.push("");
    for (const t of wrapB64(b64Encode(sp.att.text)).split("\r\n")) L.push(t);
    L.push("--" + b + "--");
    L.push("");
  } else {
    L.push("Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8; format=flowed");
    L.push("Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit");
    L.push("");
    for (const t of sp.b) L.push(t);
    L.push("");
  }
  return L.join("\r\n");
}

  { c:"info", f:["Service Communication - Université de Valmont","communication@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-09-29T11:03", s:"[InfoValmont] L'université rejoint le consortium européen UNITE", auto:true, b:[
  "Chers personnels,","",
  "Nous sommes heureux d'annoncer que l'Université de Valmont a été retenue",
  "aux côtés de 11 partenaires européens dans le consortium UNITE",
  "(Universities Network for Inclusive Technology in Europe).","",
  "Ce consortium ouvrira à nos équipes un accès à des financements complémentaires",
  "et à des programmes de mobilité renforcés à partir de 2027.","",
  "Communiqué complet : https://www.univ-valmont.fr/actualites/unite-2027","",
  "English summary:",
  "The University of Valmont has joined UNITE, a network of 12 European",
  "universities unlocking new funding and mobility programmes from 2027.","",
  "Le Service Communication"]},

  { c:"info", f:["Christine Moreau","christine.moreau@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-09T09:12", s:"Pensez à saisir vos ordres de mission AVANT vos déplacements d'octobre", b:[

  { c:"info", f:["Service Gestion des Bâtiments","batiments@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-12T08:05", s:"Fermeture de l'ascenseur - bâtiment C, du 12 au 23 octobre", auto:true, b:[

  { c:"info", f:["Laboratoire LIAV - Séminaires","seminaires@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-09-30T11:47", s:"Séminaire du laboratoire - 8 octobre : Pr. Sarah Whitfield (University of Aldergate)", b:[
  "Chers membres du laboratoire,","",
  "Notre collègue Sarah Whitfield (University of Aldergate, UK) ouvrira le cycle",
  "de séminaires de l'automne :","",
  "  Jeudi 8 octobre, 11h - salle de conférences du LIAV",
  "  « Toward sustainable LLM inference: scheduling, batching and all that »","",
  "Résumé : the talk will review recent results on adaptive batching for",
  "transformer inference and discuss open questions on energy-aware serving.","",
  "Un buffet sera servi à 12h30, merci de vous inscrire pour le déjeuner :",
  "https://doodle.com/liav-seminaire-0810","",
  "Le comité séminaires du LIAV"]},
  { c:"info", f:["Université de Valmont - Culture et Société","evenements@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-03T10:00", s:"Journée portes ouvertes du samedi 21 novembre - appel aux volontaires", auto:true, b:[

  { c:"info", f:["DSI - Université de Valmont","dsi@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-21T12:02", s:"ALERTE - campagne de phishing en cours : ne communiquez jamais votre mot de passe", auto:true, b:[

  { c:"student", f:["Camille Durand","camille.durand@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-09-29T18:34", s:"Demande de changement de groupe de TD - Bases de données", b:[

  { c:"student", t:"yanis", f:["Yanis Haddad","yanis.haddad@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-01T08:47", s:"Absence au CC d'algorithmique du 30/09 - justificatif", b:[

  { c:"student", f:["Hugo Rousseau","hugo.rousseau@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-05T17:51", s:"Projet de programmation parallèle - travail en binôme autorisé ?", b:[

  { c:"student", t:"ines", f:["Inès Bernard","ines.bernard@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-08T12:09", s:"Question au nom de plusieurs étudiants - barème du CC d'algorithmique", b:[

  { c:"student", f:["Manon Girard","manon.girard@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-12T19:26", s:"Demande de lettre de recommandation - stage M2", b:[

  { c:"student", f:["Nathan Boyer","nathan.boyer@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-13T11:31", s:"Erasmus au semestre 2 - votre UE est-elle compatible ?", b:[

  { c:"student", t:"kevin", f:["Kevin Traoré","kevin.traore@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-14T22:18", s:"Délai supplémentaire pour le projet de programmation parallèle (48h)", b:[

  "La partition GPU du cluster pédagogique est hors service depuis mardi",
  "(tickets #45190 et suivants), ce qui nous a bloqués sur les benchmarks du",
  "projet. Est-il possible d'avoir 48h de délai pour rendre le projet ?","",
  "Nous avons presque terminé, il ne manque que les mesures de performance.","",
  "Désolé pour la demande tardive, merci de votre compréhension.",
  "Kevin Traoré - M2 Informatique"]},
  { c:"student", t:"kevin", f:["Kevin Traoré","kevin.traore@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-16T14:05", s:"Re: délai accordé - merci beaucoup", b:[

  "Merci beaucoup pour votre souplesse.","",

  ">",

  "Le rendu sera déposé sur Moodle dimanche soir. Encore merci.","",
  "Bien cordialement,",
  "Kevin Traoré - M2 Informatique"]},
  { c:"student", f:["Julie Marchal","julie.marchal@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-15T17:40", s:"Note du CC saisie deux fois sur l'ENT ?", b:[

  { c:"student", f:["Bastien Chevalier","bastien.chevalier@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-19T08:55", s:"Convention de stage à signer - puis-je passer jeudi ?", b:[

  { c:"work", t:"sarah", f:["Sarah Whitfield","s.whitfield@aldergate.ac.uk"], d:"2026-10-05T10:02", s:"Re: Draft v3 of our paper - Section 4 needs reworking", b:[
  "Hi Arno,","",
  "I finally got through the whole draft. Sections 1-3 read well, but I think",
  "Section 4 (the scheduler evaluation) is our weak spot: the baselines are",
  "too old (2022-era schedulers) and reviewer 2 will notice, as they did for",
  "the SCALE-UP submission.","",
  "Could we re-run the comparison with DRArT and ShOt at least? I can free up",
  "the Aldergate cluster next week.","",
  "Best,",
  "Sarah",
  "Prof. Sarah Whitfield - Department of Computer Science",
  "University of Aldergate"]},
  { c:"work", t:"sarah", f:["Sarah Whitfield","s.whitfield@aldergate.ac.uk"], d:"2026-10-08T09:35", s:"Re: Section 4 - agreed on the plan", b:[
  "Hi Arno,","",
  "> Hi Sarah,",
  ">",
  "> Agreed on both counts. Let's add DRArT and ShOt as baselines, and split",
  "> the scheduling figure into two (throughput / energy). I'll draft 4.1-4.2",
  "> if you take 4.3-4.4 and the discussion.",
  ">",
  "> Arno","",
  "Perfect. I'll start with 4.3 tonight and send you something by Friday.",
  "Let's aim for a submission before Christmas so we land in the February",
  "window.","",
  "Sarah"]},
  { c:"work", t:"sarah", f:["Sarah Whitfield","s.whitfield@aldergate.ac.uk"], d:"2026-10-12T16:48", s:"4.2 rewritten - can you sanity-check the benchmark table?", b:[
  "Hi Arno,","",
  "Section 4.2 is rewritten and the numbers are in. Two things to check please:","",
  "  - Table 2: the energy numbers for ShOt look suspiciously good on the",
  "    64-node config. I suspect a unit mix-up (W vs kW?), can you verify",
  "    against your logs?",
  "  - Fig. 3 caption: I described the confidence intervals as 95% but the",
  "    script computes 90%.","",
  "Everything else is ready for my part. Once you confirm, I'll open the",
  "final pass on the introduction.","",
  "Thanks!",
  "Sarah"]},
  { c:"work", t:"sarah", f:["Sarah Whitfield","s.whitfield@aldergate.ac.uk"], d:"2026-10-16T11:24", s:"Re: final pass + cover letter - can we submit Friday?", b:[
  "Hi Arno,","",
  "Your fixes are in, the CI script is corrected, and I've just pushed the",
  "final version of the introduction. Shall we submit on Friday afternoon so",
  "the work is off our desks before the NEPTUNE proposal deadline eats our",
  "weekend?","",
  "I drafted the cover letter; just replace the bit I flagged [EDITOR].","",
  "Sarah"]},
  { c:"work", t:"scaleup", f:["Elena Marchetti - PC Chair SCALE-UP 2027","pc2027@scale-up2027.org"], d:"2026-10-03T09:18", s:"Invitation to serve on the Program Committee - SCALE-UP 2027", b:[
  "Dear Prof. Lesage,","",
  "On behalf of the Steering Committee, I would like to invite you to serve on",
  "the Program Committee of SCALE-UP 2027, the 16th International Conference on",
  "Scalable Computing and Architectures, to be held in Turin, June 14-16.","",
  "As a PC member you would review about 6 papers (double-blind) between",
  "February 15 and March 20, and participate in the virtual PC meeting on",
  "March 25.","",
  "Please confirm by October 12 using the link below.","",
  "With best regards,",
  "Prof. Elena Marchetti - PC Chair, SCALE-UP 2027"]},
  { c:"work", t:"scaleup", f:["Elena Marchetti - PC Chair SCALE-UP 2027","pc2027@scale-up2027.org"], d:"2026-10-10T08:44", s:"Reminder: PC confirmation + conflict declaration due October 12", auto:true, b:[
  "Dear PC member,","",
  "A short reminder: confirmations and conflict-of-interest declarations for",
  "SCALE-UP 2027 are due October 12 (Tuesday). Members who have not confirmed",
  "by then will be replaced from the waiting list.","",
  "https://scale-up2027.org/pc/confirm","",
  "Best regards,",
  "Elena Marchetti"]},
  { c:"work", t:"scaleup", f:["Elena Marchetti - PC Chair SCALE-UP 2027","pc2027@scale-up2027.org"], d:"2026-10-18T18:29", s:"Review assignments are out - bidding closes October 25", b:[
  "Dear Arno,","",
  "Good to have you on board again. Papers are now in the bidding system:",
  "please rank your preferences (I have pre-assigned you 2 papers on energy-aware",
  "scheduling, given your recent work). Bidding closes October 25.","",
  "Merci for the quick confirmation, and a presto,",
  "Elena"]},
  { c:"work", t:"neptune", f:["Béatrice Nguyen","beatrice.nguyen@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-06T14:26", s:"Idée pour l'AAP Impact 2027 - projet NEPTUNE", b:[
  "Bonjour Arno,","",
  "L'appel à projets Interdisciplinaire 2027 (AAP Impact) est sorti : 250 kEUR",
  "sur 3 ans, lettre d'intention courte pour un projet data/énergie.","",
  "Je pense à un truc qui fédérerait nos deux équipes : « NEPTUNE -",
  "planification énergétique des infrastructures de calcul par apprentissage ».",
  "Toi le scheduling et les mesures, moi la partie apprentissage, et on pourrait",
  "embarquer la ville de Valmont comme partenaire (data des bâtiments",
  "municipaux).","",
  "Ça te dirait d'en discuter autour d'un café cette semaine ?","",
  "Béatrice",
  "Béatrice Nguyen - Maître de conférences - LIAV / équipe APPRIS"]},
  { c:"work", t:"neptune", f:["Béatrice Nguyen","beatrice.nguyen@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-09T10:31", s:"Re: NEPTUNE - premier budget, ça te va ?", b:[
  "Bonjour Arno,","",
  "> Salut Béatrice,",
  ">",
  "> Ça me tente bien. Si tu montes le budget, je coordonne le volet",
  "> expérimental (VEGA + capteurs du campus). Question : on pense doctorant ou",
  "> post-doc pour le premier appel ?",
  ">",
  "> Arno","",
  "J'ai fait le tour avec la direction : un doctorant + un poste d'ingénieur",
  "24 mois passe mieux dans la grille d'évaluation. Premier jet de budget :","",
  "  - 1 doctorant (36 mois) : 105 kEUR",
  "  - 1 ingénieur d'étude (24 mois) : 88 kEUR",
  "  - équipements / missions : 22 kEUR",
  "  - fonctionnement / valorisation : 12 kEUR",
  "  Total : 227 kEUR + 8% de frais de gestion","",
  "La lettre d'intention est courte (5 pages), on l'écrit à deux ?",
  "Béatrice"]},
  { c:"work", t:"neptune", f:["Béatrice Nguyen","beatrice.nguyen@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-14T09:14", s:"Re: NEPTUNE - ta partie de la lettre avant dimanche, si possible", b:[
  "Bonjour Arno,","",
  "J'ai rédigé l'état de l'art et le volet apprentissage de la lettre",
  "d'intention. Il me manque :","",
  "  - ta partie « infrastructure et méthodologie expérimentale » (1 page),",
  "  - les références communes (je t'ai mis 6 candidats, retire/ajoute).","",
  "Deadline de soumission : lundi 26, 13h. Si tu peux m'envoyer ça dimanche,",
  "je fais tourner la relecture au labo lundi matin.","",
  "Merci !",
  "Béatrice"]},
  { c:"work", t:"neptune", f:["Béatrice Nguyen","beatrice.nguyen@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-20T17:52", s:"Re: NEPTUNE - la direction valide le soutien du labo", b:[
  "Bonjour Arno,","",

  "On passe à l'écriture du dossier complet dès la réponse de l'appel ?","",
  "Bonne soirée,",
  "Béatrice"]},
  { c:"work", t:"jhpda", f:["Richard Aldous, Editor-in-Chief - JHPDA","eic@jhpda.org"], d:"2026-10-11T08:13", s:"Invitation to review JHPDA-2026-114", b:[

  "Sincerely,",
  "Richard Aldous - Editor-in-Chief, JHPDA"]},
  { c:"work", t:"jhpda", f:["Richard Aldous, Editor-in-Chief - JHPDA","eic@jhpda.org"], d:"2026-10-18T08:02", s:"Gentle reminder - review of JHPDA-2026-114 due November 20", auto:true, b:[

  { c:"work", t:"jhpda", f:["Richard Aldous, Editor-in-Chief - JHPDA","eic@jhpda.org"], d:"2026-10-20T13:37", s:"Thank you for accepting - JHPDA-2026-114", auto:true, b:[

  { c:"work", t:"ubl", f:["Miguel Santos","m.santos@ubl.pt"], d:"2026-10-13T15:44", s:"Invitation - plenary talk at UBL Tech Days, Lisbon, December 3-4", b:[
  "Dear Prof. Lesage,","",
  "On behalf of the organizing committee of the UBL Tech Days (Universidade da",
  "Beira Litoral, Lisbon campus), I am delighted to invite you to give a",
  "plenary talk (40 min + questions) on energy-aware scheduling of HPC",
  "platforms.","",
  "The event covers travel (economy) and two nights of accommodation. December",
  "3-4, with a dinner on the 3rd and the doctoral symposium on the 4th, where",
  "a plenary speaker is traditionally asked to say a few kind words to the",
  "students.","",
  "Would you be available?",
  "Com os melhores cumprimentos,",
  "Prof. Miguel Santos - Departamento de Engenharia Informatica, UBL"]},
  { c:"work", t:"ubl", f:["Miguel Santos","m.santos@ubl.pt"], d:"2026-10-17T11:09", s:"Re: UBL Tech Days - travel and draft itinerary", att:{ name:"ubl_techdays_itinerary.ics", ctype:"text/calendar", text:ICS_UBL }, b:[
  "Caro Professor,","",

  "> details and I'll let our international office handle the rest.",
  ">",
  "> Arno","",
  "Wonderful! Draft itinerary: flight Friday Dec 2 evening (I attach the",
  "current plan as an .ics), hotel Almarba booked by us, return Sunday Dec 5",
  "morning. Our administration will contact yours with the guest documents.","",
  "Until then,",
  "Miguel"]},
  { c:"work", t:"sylvain", f:["Sylvain Rambert","sylvain.rambert@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-02T09:41", s:"Progression M1 - on cale les CC ?", b:[

  { c:"work", t:"sylvain", f:["Sylvain Rambert","sylvain.rambert@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-07T16:22", s:"Re: sujets des CC - je peux t'en refiler un ?", b:[

  { c:"work", t:"raph", f:["Raphaël Vinot","raphael.vinot@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-07T18:05", s:"Chapitre 3 envoyé - retours avant la réunion du 15 ?", b:[
  "Bonjour Arno,","",
  "Je viens de déposer la version 2 du chapitre 3 (ordonnancement sous",
  "contraintes énergétiques) sur le dépôt partagé. J'ai intégré les",
  "commentaires de Béatrice sur l'état de l'art et ajouté la preuve de la",
  "proposition 3.5 (avec l'annexe qui va bien).","",

  "Merci d'avance,",
  "Raphaël",

  { c:"work", t:"raph", f:["Raphaël Vinot","raphael.vinot@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-14T11:16", s:"Re: Chapitre 3 - merci ! Deux questions sur la section 3.2", b:[
  "Bonjour Arno,","",

  ">",
  "> Très bonne version. Deux points : la section 3.2 mérite un schéma",
  "> (le lemme 3.3 est difficile à suivre sans figure), et vérifie",
  "> l'hypothèse H2, elle me semble superflue.",
  ">",
  "> Arno","",
  "Merci beaucoup ! Pour 3.2 : d'accord, je fais une figure TikZ d'ici la",
  "soutenance. Deux questions sur le reste :","",
  "  1. Si je retire H2, la proposition 3.5 ne tient plus que pour les",
  "     topologies régulières - est-ce que je le formule comme une extension",
  "     ou je borne le chapitre au cas régulier ?",
  "  2. Peux-tu jeter un oeil à l'intro du chapitre 4 avant que je l'envoie",
  "     à Béatrice ?","",
  "Merci pour ta disponibilité,",
  "Raphaël"]},
  { c:"work", t:"raph", f:["Raphaël Vinot","raphael.vinot@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-21T15:38", s:"Financement conférence SCALE-UP 2027 - budget possible ?", b:[

  { c:"work", t:"louna", f:["Louna Berthier","louna.berthier@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-09T08:52", s:"Réunion de suivi - je serai en visio jeudi", b:[

  { c:"work", t:"christine", f:["Christine Moreau","christine.moreau@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-04T14:37", s:"Note de frais mission Barcelone - justificatif d'hôtel manquant", b:[

  { c:"work", t:"christine", f:["Christine Moreau","christine.moreau@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-12T13:41", s:"Ordre de mission Lisbonne (décembre) - prêt à signer", b:[

  { c:"work", t:"okafor", f:["Daniel Okafor","d.okafor@itk.edu.ng"], d:"2026-10-10T12:26", s:"Sabbatical visit at LIAV - February to May 2027?", b:[
  "Dear Prof. Lesage,","",
  "I hope this email finds you well. My sabbatical was approved for February",
  "to July 2027, and I would dearly love to spend the first four months",
  "(February-May) with your group in Valmont, building on our discussions",
  "at the SCALE-UP 2025 winter school about energy profiling of embedded",
  "clusters.","",
  "My university covers my salary; I would need office space and, if",
  "possible, affiliation for the visiting researcher programme.","",
  "Would the LIAV be willing to host me? I can prepare any documents",
  "required.","",
  "Warm regards,",
  "Prof. Daniel Okafor - Dept. of Computer Engineering",
  "Institute of Technology Kano (ITK)"]},
  { c:"work", t:"okafor", f:["Daniel Okafor","d.okafor@itk.edu.ng"], d:"2026-10-14T09:03", s:"Re: Sabbatical visit - documents for the international office", b:[
  "Dear Prof. Lesage,","",
  "> Dear Daniel,",
  ">",
  "> Delighted - the LIAV would be happy to host you. I have talked to the",
  "> lab direction and we can offer an office (C-209), VEGA access and the",
  "> visiting researcher affiliation. Send me your CV and a short project",
  "> plan and I will start the paperwork.",
  ">",
  "> Arno","",
  "Thank you so much, this is wonderful news.","",
  "Attached to my next email you will find: CV, project plan (2 pages on",
  "energy-aware profiling of embedded HPC clusters), and passport scan for",
  "the university's international office. Please tell me if any form in",
  "particular is required by the Université de Valmont.","",
  "With my gratitude,",
  "Daniel"]},
  { c:"work", t:"jury", f:["École doctorale SIM - Soutenances","ed-sim@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-19T10:05", s:"Composition du jury - thèse d'Anaïs Ropert (soutenance 12 décembre)", b:[
  "Bonjour Monsieur Lesage,","",
  "Dans le cadre de la préparation de la soutenance d'Anaïs Ropert (doctorante",
  "sous la direction de Sylvain Rambert, LIAV), votre nom a été proposé comme",
  "membre du jury en qualité d'examinateur. La soutenance est prévue le",
  "vendredi 12 décembre 2026, 14h, amphi 3.","",
  "Merci de me confirmer votre accord et de me signaler tout conflit",
  "d'intérêt avec les autres membres pressentis (liste ci-dessous) avant le",
  "23 octobre.","",
  "Cordialement,",
  "Valérie Cochet - École doctorale SIM","",
  "Jury pressenti : S. Rambert (directeur), A. Lesage (examinateur),",
  "M. Le Goff (Univ. Pontcroix, rapporteur), K. Ostrowska (Univ. Beira Litoral, rapporteuse)"]},
  { c:"work", t:"jury", f:["École doctorale SIM - Soutenances","ed-sim@univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-22T14:28", s:"Re: jury A. Ropert - dernier point avant envoi à la maison doctorale", b:[

  { c:"other", t:"ambre", f:["Ambre Collet","ambre.collet@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-08T21:47", s:"Situation personnelle difficile - je pense devoir suspendre mes études", b:[

  { c:"other", f:["Marion Delaunay","marion.delaunay@gmail.com"], d:"2026-10-18T20:15", s:"Cinq ans après - un conseil de carrière ? (promo 2019)", b:[

  { c:"other", t:"conflit", f:["Sarah Kaminski","sarah.kaminski@etu.univ-valmont.fr"], d:"2026-10-12T08:39", s:"Deux partiels le même jour (20/11) - que dois-je faire ?", b:[

  const rnd = mulberry32(20261024);
  const sorted = specs.map(function(sp, i){ return { sp: sp, i: i }; })
    .sort(function(a, b){ return a.sp.d < b.sp.d ? -1 : (a.sp.d > b.sp.d ? 1 : a.i - b.i); })
    .map(function(x){ return x.sp; });
  const threadState = {};
  const files = [];
  sorted.forEach(function(sp, idx) {
    const id = hexId(rnd, 12) + "@" + sp.f[1].split("@")[1];
    let irt = null, refs = [];
    if (sp.t) {
      const st = threadState[sp.t] || (threadState[sp.t] = { refs: [] });
      if (st.refs.length) { irt = st.refs[st.refs.length - 1]; refs = st.refs.slice(); }
    }
    const content = buildEml(sp, id, irt, refs, rnd);
    if (sp.t) threadState[sp.t].refs.push(id);
    const num = String(idx + 1).padStart(3, "0");
    const name = num + "_" + slugify(sp.s) + ".eml";
    files.push({ num: num, name: name, content: content, cat: sp.c, thread: sp.t || "", d: sp.d, from: sp.f[1], s: sp.s });
  });
  return files;
}

function buildIndexCsv(files) {
  const esc = function(v) { return "\"" + String(v).replace(/"/g, "\"\"") + "\""; };
  const rows = ["num,filename,datetime,category,thread,from,subject"];
  for (const f of files) {
    rows.push([f.num, f.name, f.d, f.cat, f.thread, f.from, f.s].map(esc).join(","));
  }
  return rows.join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
}

function buildMbox(files) {
  let out = "";
  for (const f of files) {
    const safe = f.content.replace(/\r\nFrom /g, "\r\n>From ");
    out += asctime(f.d) + "\r\n" + safe + "\r\n\r\n";
  }
  return out;
}

async function main() {
  const files = buildAll();
  const cats = {};
  for (const f of files) cats[f.cat] = (cats[f.cat] || 0) + 1;
  const expected = { spam: 7, unrelated: 23, info: 30, student: 30, work: 45, other: 15 };
  if (files.length !== 150) throw new Error("Total inattendu: " + files.length);
  for (const k in expected) {
    if ((cats[k] || 0) !== expected[k]) throw new Error("Catégorie " + k + ": " + (cats[k] || 0) + " != " + expected[k]);
  }

  // --- Ecrire les 150 fichiers EML ---
  for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i += 25) {
    const batch = files.slice(i, i + 25);
    await Promise.all(batch.map(function(f) {
      return tools.file_system.write_file({ path: "/home/user/fake-inbox/eml/" + f.name, content: f.content });
    }));
  }
  await tools.file_system.write_file({ path: "/home/user/fake-inbox/inbox.mbox", content: buildMbox(files) });
  await tools.file_system.write_file({ path: "/home/user/fake-inbox/index.csv", content: buildIndexCsv(files) });
  await tools.file_system.write_file({ path: "/home/user/fake-inbox/README.md", content: readmeText() });

  // --- Script autonome (Node.js) pour le canvas ---
  const HEAD = [
    "#!/usr/bin/env node",
    "// ============================================================================",
    "// generate_inbox.mjs - Faux inbox universitaire de 150 e-mails (format EML)",
    "// Pr. Arno Lesage - Département d'informatique - Université de Valmont (fictive)",
    "// Usage : node generate_inbox.mjs [dossier]   (par défaut : ./fake-inbox)",
    "// Produit : eml/ (150 fichiers .eml) + inbox.mbox + index.csv + README.md",
    "// Aucune dépendance - Node.js >= 16 - génération déterministe (graine fixe)",
    "// ============================================================================",
    "import fs from \"node:fs\";",
    "import path from \"node:path\";",
    "",
    "const DAYS = " + JSON.stringify(DAYS) + ";",
    "const MONTHS = " + JSON.stringify(MONTHS) + ";",
    "const PROF_TO = " + JSON.stringify(PROF_TO) + ";",
    ""
  ].join("\n");
  const fns = [mulberry32, hexId, isAscii, b64Encode, wrapB64, encodeHeader, rfc2822Date, asctime, slugify, buildEml, buildAll, buildIndexCsv, buildMbox, readmeText];
  const FOOT = [
    "",
    "const OUT = process.argv[2] || \"fake-inbox\";",
    "const files = buildAll();",
    "fs.mkdirSync(path.join(OUT, \"eml\"), { recursive: true });",
    "for (const f of files) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, \"eml\", f.name), f.content);",
    "fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, \"inbox.mbox\"), buildMbox(files));",
    "fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, \"index.csv\"), buildIndexCsv(files));",
    "fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, \"README.md\"), readmeText());",
    "const cats = {};",
    "for (const f of files) cats[f.cat] = (cats[f.cat] || 0) + 1;",
    "console.log(\"Généré : \" + files.length + \" e-mails dans \" + path.join(OUT, \"eml\") + \" + inbox.mbox, index.csv, README.md\");",
    "console.log(\"Répartition : \" + JSON.stringify(cats));",
    ""
  ].join("\n");
  const standalone = HEAD + "\n" + fns.map(function(f){ return f.toString(); }).join("\n\n") + "\n" + FOOT;

  const canvas = [
    "---",
    "name: fake-inbox",
    "title: \"Générateur de faux inbox universitaire (150 e-mails EML)\"",
    "type: code",
    "language: javascript",
    "---",
    standalone
  ].join("\n");
  await tools.file_system.write_file({ path: "/home/user/canvases/fake-inbox/CANVAS.md", content: canvas });

  return {
    total: files.length,
    cats: cats,
    first: files[0].name,
    last: files[files.length - 1].name,
    sample: files[18].content.slice(0, 700),
    standaloneBytes: standalone.length
  };
}

function utf8Bytes(s) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    let c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c < 0x80) out.push(c);
    else if (c < 0x800) { out.push(0xC0 | (c >> 6), 0x80 | (c & 63)); }
    else if (c >= 0xD800 && c <= 0xDBFF) {
      const c2 = s.charCodeAt(i + 1); i++;
      const cp = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xD800) << 10) + (c2 - 0xDC00);
      out.push(0xF0 | (cp >> 18), 0x80 | ((cp >> 12) & 63), 0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (cp & 63));
    } else { out.push(0xE0 | (c >> 12), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63)); }
  }
  return out;
}

Bonjour Monsieur,

Avec le club Info et deux entreprises partenaires, le BDE organise un
hackathon étudiant de 24 heures les 14-15 novembre, sur le thème
« IA et énergie ». Une centaine de participants est attendue.

proposer deux ou trois sujets de défi, dire quelques mots au
lancement, et aider le jury à départager les trois équipes finalistes.

(cadrage des sujets le 3 ou 4 novembre, remise des prix le 15 à 17h).

la note de service hebdomadaire.

Hélène

# Fake university inbox — 150 e-mails (.eml)

A realistic, fully fictional received-mailbox for Pr. Arno Lesage, professor of
computer science at the (fictional) Université de Valmont, France.

## What's here
- `eml/` — 150 individual RFC-5322 e-mail files (UTF-8, CRLF, MIME-encoded
  subjects, proper Message-ID / In-Reply-To / References threading, 3 mails with
  base64 attachments).
- `inbox.mbox` — the same 150 messages in a single mbox file.
- `index.csv` — one row per message: num, filename, datetime, category, thread,
  from, subject.
- `categories.txt` — num → category map.

## Distribution (as requested)
| Category | Count | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Spam / phishing | 7 | ~5% |
| Unrelated (2FA codes, wrong recipient, personal, auto-replies) | 23 | 15% |
| Information / newsletters (no answer needed, FR + EN summary) | 30 | 20% |
| Student questions needing a one-line answer | 30 | 20% |
| Work & research conversations | 45 | 30% |
| Other (particular student needs, complex threads) | 15 | 10% |

## Persona & cast (all fictional)
- **Pr. Arno Lesage** <arno.lesage@univ-valmont.fr> — CS professor, M1
  coordinator, member of lab LIAV.
- Administration: Hélène Vasseur (direction des études), Christine Moreau
  (LIAV secrétariat), Karim Benali (scolarité), Marc Delacroix (DSI),
  Mathilde Roux (mission handicap), DSI/DRH/ED SIM/BU/services...
- Colleagues: Sylvain Rambert, Béatrice Nguyen, Julien Perrot.
- PhD students: Raphaël Vinot (3rd year), Louna Berthier (2nd year).
- ~30 students, French- and English-speaking, plus international partners:
  Sarah Whitfield (Univ. of Aldergate, UK), Miguel Santos (UBL Lisbon),
  Daniel Okafor (ITK Kano), Elena Marchetti (PC chair, SCALE-UP 2027),
  Richard Aldous (JHPDA journal), Marc Le Goff (Univ. de Pontcroix),
  Paul Estève (IRIS Saint-Martin).
- Fictional companies: Kerdata, Kelvix, Gridpulse.

## Timeline & threads
All messages are dated 28 Sep – 23 Oct 2026. Multi-message threads use real
In-Reply-To/References chains (e.g. the Whitfield paper thread, the
Kaminski exam-clash thread, the Collet and Ferber support threads, the
NEPTUNE funding thread). Replies from the professor appear quoted with ">"
inside follow-ups — only received messages are included.

## Importing into Thunderbird
- All 150 at once: install *ImportExportTools NG*, right-click a folder →
  ImportExportTools NG → Import mbox file → pick `inbox.mbox`.
- Or by file: ImportExportTools NG → Import all messages from a directory →
  pick `eml/` (plain .eml files also drag-and-drop onto a folder).

## Disclaimer
Everything here is fictional: names, addresses, domains, events and
companies. Do not send mail to these addresses and do not click the
phishing links — several messages intentionally mimic real phishing
patterns for training/testing purposes.

bash


cd /home/user/fake-inbox
MONTH=( Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec )
MNUM=( 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12 )
csvq() {
  local s="$1"
  case "$s" in
    *\"*|*,*|*$'\n'*|*$'\r'*)
      s=${s//\"/\"\"}
      printf '"%s"' "$s"
      ;;
    *) printf '%s' "$s" ;;
  esac
}

echo 'num,filename,datetime,category,thread,from,subject' > index.csv
for f in eml/*.eml; do
  base=$(basename "$f" .eml)
  num=${base%%_*}
  # category
  cat=$(awk -v n="$num" '$1==n{print $2}' categories.txt)
  # Date
  d=$(grep -m1 '^Date:' "$f" | tr -d '\r' | sed -E 's/^Date: [A-Za-z]{3}, ([0-9]{2}) ([A-Za-z]{3}) ([0-9]{4}) ([0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2}):[0-9]{2} .*/\1|\2|\3|\4:\5/')
  IFS='|' read -r day mon yr hm <<< "$d"
  mn=$(for i in "${!MONTH[@]}"; do [ "${MONTH[$i]}" = "$mon" ] && echo "${MNUM[$i]}"; done)
  datetime="$yr-$mn-$day $hm"
  # Message-ID / References
  mid=$(grep -m1 '^Message-ID:' "$f" | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^Message-ID: //')
  ref=$(grep -m1 '^References:' "$f" | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^References: //')
  thread=${ref%% *}
  [ -z "$thread" ] && thread=$mid
  # From
  from=$(grep -m1 '^From:' "$f" | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^From: //')
  # Subject decode
  subj=$(grep -m1 '^Subject:' "$f" | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^Subject: //')
  if [[ "$subj" == '=?'*'?' ]]; then
    b=$(printf '%s' "$subj" | sed 's/=?UTF-8?B?//g; s/?=//g')
    subj=$(printf '%s' "$b" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null)
  fi
  row="$(csvq "$num"),$(csvq "$base.eml"),$(csvq "$datetime"),$(csvq "$cat"),$(csvq "$thread"),$(csvq "$from"),$(csvq "$subj")"
  echo "$row" >> index.csv
done
wc -l index.csv

#!/usr/bin/env node
// fake-inbox-pack.mjs — Fake university inbox (150 e-mails, .eml)
//
// Regenerates the complete fictional inbox of Pr. Arno Lesage
// (Université de Valmont — entirely fictional):
//
//   <out>/eml/001_....eml … 150 received messages (UTF-8, CRLF)
//   <out>/inbox.mbox       — same 150 messages as a single mbox
//   <out>/index.csv        — num, filename, datetime, category, thread, from, subject
//   <out>/categories.txt   — NNN category map
//   <out>/README.md       — documentation
//
// Usage:   node fake-inbox-pack.mjs [output-dir]    (default: ./fake-inbox)
// Needs:   Node.js >= 16, no external dependencies.
// Warning: all names, addresses and events are fictional. Several messages
//          intentionally mimic phishing — do not click their links.

import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";

const FILES = {



Tail:
js


};

const outDir = process.argv[2] || "fake-inbox";
const emlDir = join(outDir, "eml");
mkdirSync(emlDir, { recursive: true });

const decoded = {};
let count = 0;
for (const [name, b64] of Object.entries(FILES)) {
  const text = Buffer.from(b64, "base64").toString("utf8");
  decoded[name] = text;
  if (name.endsWith(".eml")) { writeFileSync(join(emlDir, name), text); count++; }
  else writeFileSync(join(outDir, name), text);
}

// ---- rebuild inbox.mbox (LF endings, mboxrd escaping) ----
function asctime(dateHdr) {
  const m = dateHdr.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3}), (\d{1,2}) ([A-Za-z]{3}) (\d{4}) (\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})/);
  return m ? `${m[1]} ${m[3]} ${m[2]} ${m[5]} ${m[4]}` : "Thu Jan  1 00:00:00 1970";
}
let mbox = "";
for (const name of Object.keys(FILES).filter(n => n.endsWith(".eml")).sort()) {
  const text = decoded[name];
  const date = (text.match(/^Date: (.+)$/m) || [])[1] || "";
  mbox += "From MAILER-DAEMON " + asctime(date) + "\n";
  mbox += text.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").replace(/^From /gm, ">From ");
  if (!mbox.endsWith("\n\n")) mbox += "\n";
}
writeFileSync(join(outDir, "inbox.mbox"), mbox);
console.log(`Wrote ${count} e-mails to ${emlDir}`);
console.log(`Wrote inbox.mbox, index.csv, categories.txt, README.md to ${outDir}`);

Find the output in ./fake-inbox/ (or pass a custom folder: node fake-inbox-pack.mjs C:\Users\you\Desktop\inbox)

eml/ — 150 individual .eml message files

inbox.mbox — all 150 messages in one mailbox file

index.csv + categories.txt — the catalog and category map

README.md — full documentation


Import into Thunderbird (pick one method)

Mbox: right-click a folder → ImportExportTools NG → Import mbox file → select inbox.mbox

Or .eml files: ImportExportTools NG → Import all messages from a directory → select eml/

Or simply drag-and-drop .eml files from the file manager onto a Thunderbird folder




In short:
Copy the code from the canvas (its copy/export control) and save it as fake-inbox-pack.mjs
Run it: node fake-inbox-pack.mjs — it creates a fake-inbox/ folder next to where you run it, or specify your own: node fake-inbox-pack.mjs ~/Desktop/inbox
Import into Thunderbird: drag-and-drop the .eml files onto a folder, or use the ImportExportTools NG add-on with inbox.mbox (all 150 at once) or the eml/ directory
The only requirement is Node.js 16+ (node --version) — no npm install, since everything (the 150 messages, index, and README) is embedded in the script itself. It's deterministic, so you can delete and regenerate the folder as many times as you like.

  @keyframes intercom-lightweight-app-launcher {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(0.5);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1);
    }
  }

  @keyframes intercom-lightweight-app-gradient {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }

  @keyframes intercom-lightweight-app-messenger {
    0% {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(0);
    }
    40% {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    100% {
      transform: scale(1);
    }
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 2147483001;
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    font-family: system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol";
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-gradient {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 2147483002;
    width: 500px;
    height: 500px;
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(
      ellipse at bottom right,
      rgba(29, 39, 54, 0.16) 0%,
      rgba(29, 39, 54, 0) 72%);
    animation: intercom-lightweight-app-gradient 200ms ease-out;
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 2147483003;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border: none;
    bottom: 20px;
    right: 20px;
    max-width: 48px;
    width: 48px;
    max-height: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #FA500F;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), 0 2px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
    transition: transform 167ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 0.00, 0.00, 1.00);
    box-sizing: content-box;
  }


  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher:hover {
    transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 0.00, 0.00, 1.00);
    transform: scale(1.1)
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher:active {
    transform: scale(0.85);
    transition: transform 134ms cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.2, 1);
  }


  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher:focus {
    outline: none;

    
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    transition: transform 100ms linear, opacity 80ms linear;
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon-open {
    
        opacity: 1;
        transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
      
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon-open svg {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon-open svg path {
    fill: rgb(255, 255, 255);
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon-self-serve {
    
        opacity: 1;
        transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
      
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon-self-serve svg {
    height: 44px;
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon-self-serve svg path {
    fill: rgb(255, 255, 255);
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-custom-icon-open {
    max-height: 24px;
    max-width: 24px;

    
        opacity: 1;
        transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
      
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon-minimize {
    
        opacity: 0;
        transform: rotate(-60deg) scale(0);
      
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon-minimize svg path {
    fill: rgb(255, 255, 255);
  }

  /* Extended launcher styles */
  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher.intercom-launcher-extended {
    width: calc(180px - 30px);
    max-width: calc(180px - 30px);
    height: calc(45px - 26px);
    max-height: calc(45px - 26px);
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding: 12px 16px 12px 12px !important;
    gap: 6px;
    /* Use theme background instead of hardcoded gradient */
    background: #FA500F;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    box-shadow: 0px -2px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher.intercom-launcher-extended .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon {
    position: relative;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-text {
    /* Match text color with launcher icon */
    color: rgb(255, 255, 255);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.5;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    max-width: 140px;
    opacity: 1;
    transition: opacity 80ms linear;
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-messenger {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 2147483003;
    overflow: hidden;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    animation: intercom-lightweight-app-messenger 250ms cubic-bezier(0, 1, 1, 1);
    transform-origin: bottom right;

    
        width: 400px;
        height: calc(100% - 40px);
        max-height: 704px;
        min-height: 250px;
        right: 20px;
        bottom: 20px;
        box-shadow: 0 5px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.16);
      

    border-radius: 24px;
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-messenger-header {
    height: 64px;
    border-bottom: none;
    background: #ffffff;
  }

  .intercom-lightweight-app-messenger-footer{
    position:absolute;
    bottom:0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 80px;
    background: #ffffff;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 21px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    box-shadow: 0px 0px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  }

  @media print {
    .intercom-lightweight-app {
      display: none;
    }
  }
